verdict.rationale: Edge0 is an LLM inference engine with a serve mode (an OpenAI-compatible `edge0 serve` endpoint), so prefill/decode disaggregation is a fair axis to judge it on. The evidence pack never mentions separating prefill and decode phases across workers or nodes. Its performance features are SSD expert offload and a prerouter that predicts expert loads to improve single-node decode throughput, and it targets on-device platforms (iOS, Android, Windows, macOS) rather than large-scale distributed serving.
